message.content:
I'll search for information about altavista.com for you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>altavista.com history what happened to website</query>

Based on my search, here's what I found about **altavista.com**:

AltaVista was one of the **first major search engines** on the web, launched in **1995** by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC). It was groundbreaking for its time, offering several innovative features:

- One of the first search engines to index a large portion of the web
- Advanced search syntax (Boolean operators, phrase searching)
- Multilingual search capabilities
- Image, audio, and video search options

**What happened to AltaVista:**

- **1998**: Acquired by Compaq when it purchased DEC
- **1999**: Sold to CMGI
- **2003**: Acquired by **Yahoo!**
- **2013**: Yahoo! **shut down AltaVista** permanently on July 8, 2013

The domain **altavista.com** now redirects to Yahoo's search page. AltaVista ultimately couldn't compete with the rise of Google, which launched in 1998 and quickly dominated the search market with its superior PageRank algorithm and cleaner interface.

AltaVista serves as a classic example of an early internet pioneer that failed to adapt and was eventually eclipsed by more innovative competitors.

Sources:
1. https://www.britannica.com/topic/AltaVista
2. https://www.searchenginejournal.com/alta-vista/303709/
3. https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2013/jun/30/altavista-search-engine-closes-yahoo
4. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AltaVista
